rows.en: They're all like that… Chasing after a legend that doesn't exist, they come all the way into these deep mountains alone.
Alone…?

That's right…

On this phantom snow mountain, people forget all about their companions.
Forget about their companions? There's no way something that ridiculous could happen!
Everyone seems to think so at first… And that's when, they say, Woo appears.

…!?

What's that…!?

Huh…?

I feel like I've had a dream like this somewhere before… or maybe not…? Huh? Where was it?
Oh? Jiro, you're back already?
Yeah…
We had a wonderful time.
So… what happened to Mari and those two?
Huh…?
Did something happen to Mari and [HERO2]?
Huh…? What on earth is going on?
No, but… we came here to investigate that very monster.
Forget about their companions? There's no way something that ridiculous could happen!

…!?

What's that!? It's the Legendary Monster Woo!
No… but something's not right…?

What's more… I've seen a scene like this once before…?

No, I don't know… Why am I fighting a kaiju all by myself? Why…?
It seems someone erased Aki's and Jiro's memories.
What!? An alien?
It's possible. Go… are you sure the five of them went out together?
Yes, no doubt about it. I saw them off myself…
This may have something to do with the string of disappearances…
If this is an alien's doing… we have to go rescue them fast, or they might really end up stranded!
Let's have Aki and Jiro guide us to that mountain hut.
Right. Can I count on you two?
Yes… By the way, what kind of legend is the legend of Woo?
Ah, I see…
That's right… just like you.
"The legend of the phantom snow mountain… What am I doing here? Alone, deep in the mountains, what am I…?"

It's gotten awfully cold, hasn't it?

On a day like this, Woo just might show up…

This is it, Go!

That's where [HERO2] and the other one stayed.

Before we go in, let's get the facts straight.

First, there was an old caretaker at that hut. And you two and [HERO2]'s pair stayed in separate huts… Is that right?

Yeah.

The old caretaker asked [HERO2] and the other one, "Are you newlyweds?"…

And I was goofing around and said, "Yes, they are!" Then… he told them there was a separate hut for newlyweds…

That's this hut…
They didn't argue with that?
Nope… They looked like they were at a loss for words… Their faces were bright red.
And then, the next morning… the two of them were gone from that hut?
Yes… though I don't really remember.
It looks like Aki and Jiro escaped by some miracle, doesn't it?
But… why were they spared?

…!?

What's that!?
It's a kaiju!! A kaiju has appeared!!
Minami, take care of Aki and Jiro! Hurry to that hut!
What's this…!?
It's [HERO2] and [HERO4]…!

…!? Are they dead!?

No, wait… their hearts are still beating!
Thank goodness!
This is… They've been chilled by some special freezing method! They were frozen alive!
Ah… There's more over here!

…!?

It's Arashi and Ide of the Science Patrol! They've been frozen too!

Captain!

In that hut, we found people who'd been chilled by a special freezing method! But there's no sign of any alien!
[HERO2] and [HERO4]… and the Science Patrol people too…!
Captain! There's another hut over there.
That must be the hut we stayed in…
Right, let's take a look!!
No doubt about it, this is the hut!
Right, let's go in!
Ah…

Mari…!?

Mari, hang in there!! Mari…

She's so cold… Mari sacrificed herself to keep us warm all night long! I remember now!

Mari!! Mari!!
Mari, you really are something…
Heh heh heh…
…!? You're an alien, aren't you!?
So you've figured it out, have you?

I am Alien Black, from Saturn!

Our Saturn is short of labor! So we set our sights on Earth, in the same solar system.

The plan is to take 1,000 young couples away from Earth and have them bear many children to serve as our labor force!

Making use of Japan's "legend of the yuki-onna"… Hah hah hah…
A labor force!? You mean…
Don't screw with us! What do you think humans are!?
That goes without saying! Our puppets!
Wait!!
Whoa!!
Uwaaaagh…
Ah… MAT got beaten!!
Jiro, Aki! Hide inside the hut!
Sis!!
Yuki-onna, do it…!
Uwaaaagh…
Whoa… Ugh…
Damn it… Wait!
Ugh… Damn it… I won't lose to you!

uncertain: U13075-U13079, U13088-U13091: repeat of the Woo scene with Hayata as speaker (route variant); translated to match the earlier rows.
U13090: 'just like you' read as the keeper answering U13061 (people who come up the mountain alone).
U13093/U13095: [HERO2]さんたち rendered '[HERO2] and the other one' to keep the tag count; the partner is [HERO4].
U13094: '[HERO2]'s pair' used for [HERO2]たち to avoid adding a tag.
U13096: speaker Takeshi Minami asks Jiro; subject 'they' = the hero pair.
U13130/U13131 and U13125/U13126: split rows; narration rows continue the speaker's line.
